sources.title: MeshTailor: Cutting Seams via Generative Mesh Traversal
sources.snippet: We present MeshTailor, the first mesh-native generative framework for synthesizing edge-aligned seams on 3D surfaces. Unlike prior optimization-based or extrinsic learning-based methods, MeshTailor operates directly on the mesh graph, eliminating projection artifacts and fragile snapping heuristics.

sources.title: MeshTailor: Cutting Seams via Generative Mesh Traversal
sources.snippet: Unlike extrinsic methods that suffer from projection artifacts, MeshTailor operates natively on the mesh topology, reformulating seam placement as an au-toregressive graph traversal via a geometry-aware Pointer Network [44]. By restricting the decision space to the lo-cal 1-ring neighborhood, the model traces vertex sequences step-by-step.

sources.title: MeshTailor: Cutting Seams via Generative Mesh Traversal
sources.snippet: MeshTailor is a novel mesh-native generative framework that synthesizes high-quality, edge-aligned seams on 3D surfaces through hierarchical graph traversal, significantly improving seam coherence and reducing fragmentation compared to traditional methods.
